austin_tx.name: Project Connect Blue Line Light Rail (Downtown ↔ Airport)
austin_tx.impact: 28-mile light rail system connecting South Austin, Downtown, UT campus, and ABIA airport. Transit-oriented development catalyst along corridor.

austin_tx.name: South Central Waterfront Mixed-Use District Redevelopment
austin_tx.impact: 118-acre lakefront master plan transforming surface parking and industrial parcels into walkable mixed-use neighborhood with parks, retail, and 4,200 housing units.

austin_tx.name: Tesla Gigafactory Texas Phase 2 Expansion
austin_tx.impact: Second phase manufacturing and engineering campus expansion in southeast Travis County. Massive workforce housing demand catalyst.

denver_co.name: National Western Center Campus Redevelopment
denver_co.impact: 250-acre regeneration of historic stockyards into year-round events campus, innovation district, and mixed-use neighborhood. Adjacent to RTD N-Line commuter rail.

denver_co.name: I-70 Central Viaduct Reconstruction & Cap Park
denver_co.impact: Lowered highway segment with 4-acre freeway cap park reconnecting Globeville and Elyria-Swansea neighborhoods. Major noise reduction and land value uplift.

atlanta_ga.name: Atlanta BeltLine Westside Trail Phase 2 & Affordable TOD
atlanta_ga.impact: 22-mile multi-use corridor converting rail corridor to transit, trails, parks, and 5,600 mixed-income housing units. Proven 20-40% appreciation in adjacent parcels.

atlanta_ga.name: Microsoft East Campus & Azure Data Center Hub
atlanta_ga.impact: Regional cloud campus and engineering center bringing high-income tech workforce to metro east side.

portland_or.name: Broadway Corridor Mixed-Use Master Plan (USPS Site)
portland_or.impact: 34-acre former USPS distribution site redeveloping into Pearl District extension with 3,500 housing units, biotech labs, parks, and ground-floor retail.

tampa_fl.name: Water Street Tampa Phase 2 & USF Health Campus
tampa_fl.impact: 56-acre waterfront district adding medical campus, Class-A office towers, luxury residential, and boutique hotel. WELL-certified neighborhood transforming Channelside.

tampa_fl.name: Ybor City Historic District Revitalization & Streetcar Expansion
tampa_fl.impact: Streetcar line extension into East Tampa with adaptive-reuse historic lofts, artisan food halls, and creative office. Strong FSBO and wholesale deal flow from transitioning parcels.

utuado_pr.name: Central Mountain Eco-Tourism Corridor (PR-10 / Ruta Panorámica)
utuado_pr.impact: Federal and territorial investment in agri-tourism trail infrastructure, boutique lodging permits, and shade-grown coffee brand designation program.

st. thomas_vi.name: Red Hook Marine Terminal & Ferry Hub Modernization
st. thomas_vi.impact: Upgraded inter-island ferry terminal with new customs facility, retail promenade, and marina expansion. Increases St. Thomas accessibility and tourism capacity.

tamuning_gu.name: Marine Corps Base Camp Blaz & Defense Housing Expansion
tamuning_gu.impact: Massive US Marine Corps relocation from Okinawa bringing 5,000 military personnel and dependents. Unprecedented demand surge for off-base housing, retail, and services.
